Below is the plan for each class day. The {{< fa book >}} icon links to the relevant chapter of the online class book, the {{< fa person-chalkboard >}} icon to that day's slides, and the {{< fa pen >}} icon to the relevant assignment.

Class days come in a few recurring formats: **Q&A** days (a randomly drawn panel discusses the reading while the class asks questions), **simulation** days (play both sides of a market, then debrief), **quiz** days (a short auto-graded quiz opens at the start of class, then a normal Q&A day), and the **midterm**. Check-in, the panel draw, quizzes, and the question queue all run through our class platform (Commons).

The schedule is provisional --- topics, readings, and the exact placement of quizzes and simulations may shift as the term unfolds.
